instruction: Candid full shot at eye-level of an indoor gym with gray padded walls. On the right, the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) lunges forward to the left, throwing a straight punch. On the left, the young man in the white t-shirt (R1) stands defensively, raising both gloved hands to block the incoming strike. Both wear protective glasses and focus on the contact point of the punch. Neutral overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the gray mat floor, with a tripod visible in the background.
